The shared demo database can be reset at any time, so every check starts by registering its own customer with a fresh, unique user name. The password for these customers comes from the environment variable
Registration form fields: First Name, Last Name, Address, City, State, Zip Code, Phone #, SSN, Username, Password, Confirm. Phone # is optional; all other fields are required.

Submitting the registration form with every field empty keeps the customer on the form and shows a message next to each required field: "First name is required.", "Last name is required.", "Address is required.", "City is required.", "State is required.", "Zip Code is required.", "Social Security Number is required.", "Username is required.", "Password is required.", "Password confirmation is required.". No message is shown for Phone #.
When Password and Confirm differ, the form shows "Passwords did not match." and no customer is created (the user name cannot sign in afterwards).
A complete, valid registration opens a page with the heading "Welcome
" and the text "Your account was created successfully. You are now logged in." The customer is signed in: the left panel greets them with "Welcome
" and shows the Account Services menu.

Registering again with a user name that is already taken shows "This username already exists." next to Username and does not change the existing customer (a REST login of the existing customer still returns their original first and last name).

On the Customer Login panel, signing in with a wrong password shows an "Error!" page with "The username and password could not be verified."; signing in with both fields empty shows "Please enter a username and password."

Signing in with the registered user name and password opens the Accounts Overview page, which lists at least one account for the new customer. "Log Out" returns to the home page with the Customer Login panel.
